body: Trigger script written per moneyprinter_pipeline.md spec. Extracts MPT_TOPIC from episode header (fallback: title+location+timeline). Derives episode_id from filename. Generates mpt_payload.json. --dry-run generates payload without firing MPT. --check validates prereqs. Dry-run verified on S01E01.
title: MPT → TYLER RSI trigger — compiled/mpt_episode_trigger.sh implemented per engine spec §VI
